content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

The concept of using GitHub Pages for hosting a digital product store is built on the principle of sovereignty and independence from traditional payment platforms. By leveraging free hosting services like GitHub Pages, creators can establish a professional online presence without incurring significant costs. This approach matters because it empowers creators to take control of their digital commerce infrastructure, ensuring they are not beholden to platforms that charge exorbitant fees or impose restrictive policies.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack involves several key components, including GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. This setup allows for seamless integration of payment processing, product delivery, and order management, all without relying on conventional platforms like Stripe or PayPal. The use of crypto payments, such as USDT or Bitcoin, further enhances the sovereignty of the stack by reducing dependence on traditional financial systems.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators who operate in regions where access to conventional payment platforms is limited. These creators often face significant challenges in collecting payments for their digital products, resulting in lost revenue and stifled growth. By providing an alternative infrastructure solution, creators can bypass these restrictions and connect directly with their customers, thereby expanding their reach and increasing their earnings. For instance, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the difference in fees between Gumroad (10%) and NOWPayments (0.5%) retains $921, a significant amount for any digital business.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks empower creators to take control of their infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign digital commerce stack work together in harmony to provide a seamless and efficient sales experience. GitHub Pages offers reliable and free hosting, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, including automated product delivery and order management. NOWPayments integrates crypto payments, allowing for secure and low-fee transactions. This integrated approach ensures that creators can focus on producing high-quality digital products, knowing that their infrastructure is robust and scalable.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by selecting a suitable hosting service like GitHub Pages. Next, they need to integrate a backend logic solution, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, to handle tasks like automated product delivery. Finally, they must set up a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments to facilitate secure and low-fee transactions. By following these steps, creators can establish a fully operational online store, capable of selling digital products to customers worldwide, without relying on conventional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question a reader would ask is how to sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe. The answer lies in leveraging a sovereign digital commerce stack, which combines free hosting, backend logic, and crypto payment processing. By using GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can bypass traditional payment platforms and connect directly with their customers, ensuring a seamless and low-fee sales experience.
NOWPayments offers secure and low-fee crypto transactions, bypassing traditional payment platforms.

This kit includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, providing everything needed to establish a professional online store. By visiting https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, creators can learn more about this kit and how it can help them achieve infrastructure sovereignty and independence from traditional payment platforms.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Select a suitable hosting service like GitHub Pages, integrate a backend logic solution such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, set up a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments, configure automated product delivery and order management, test and deploy the stack, and finally, monitor and scale the infrastructure as needed. By following these concrete steps, creators can establish a fully operational online store, capable of selling digital products to customers worldwide.
